sub_sector.value: franchised personal lines property and casualty insurance agency

financial_business_type.detail: Full-service P&C agency shopping many carriers for clients, distributed via corporate and franchise network.

revenue_driver.detail: Commissions from carriers on placed policies, plus franchise-related fees and royalties.

customer_type.detail: Individuals and families buying home, auto and bundled coverage; franchisees as partners.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Agency places policies with carriers and does not underwrite risk.
